newsitem.title: USA: CME pork bellies fall sharply on technical stops.
newsitem.headline: CME pork bellies fall sharply on technical stops.

text.p: CME pork bellies turned technically weak and touched off sell stops under Friday's lows to push prices sharply lower, traders said.
March fell for a 2.050 cent loss and currently traded 1.800 lower at 75.350 cents. Other months were off 1.325 to 0.0525 cents.
Early pressure from a weak undertone to cash and concern over product moving into storage pushed prices down into the technical stops, traders said.
